name: omarchy-arabic-keyboard
description: A shareable Omarchy shell plugin with a macOS-style keyboard layout selector and Hameem Arabic keymap.

interface.shortDescription: Use Omarchy Arabic Keyboard in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds an Omarchy top-bar keyboard layout menu that lists every enabled XKB layout and includes Hameem's Arabic phonetic keymap.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use Omarchy Arabic Keyboard.
